repo.name: hostnsoft-deploy
repo.plain: Builds the apps and keeps them running

modules.summary: activator.js — wakes an app that scale-to-zero stopped, and proxies for it.

analytics/access-log-tailer.js Follows Traefik's JSON access log (TRAEFIK_ACCESS_LOG_PATH — see server-setup.sh's Traefik section, which enables --accesslog with format=json) and turns each request into one row in reques
analytics/bot-filter.js Decides whether a logged request represents a REAL visit or automated background noise.

analytics/db.js Local, per-environment time-series store backing GET /internal/apps/:appName/analytics — see access-log-tailer.js (traffic) and resource-poller.js (CPU/memory) for what populates it, and query.js for how
analytics/query.js Reads back what access-log-tailer.js and resource-poller.js have written — backs GET /internal/apps/:appName/analytics.

analytics/resource-poller.js Periodically samples every running app's CPU/memory usage and stores it in resource_sample (see db.js) — the historical counterpart to app-health.js's live-only status check.

analytics/retention.js Bounds the analytics DB's growth by pruning rows older than RETENTION_DAYS — this platform stores raw per-request rows (see access-log-tailer.js), not pre-aggregated buckets, so unpruned this would

app-health.js Backs GET /internal/apps/:appName/status — see hostnsoft-api's src/services/appHealth.ts, which is the only caller (dashboard's project-detail view, replacing the previously-hardcoded health: "unknown").
app-kind.js Answers "what is deployed under this app name on THIS host right now": a static site (static-site.js), a server app (a Nomad job), or nothing.
app-logs.js Fetches recent stdout/stderr for an app's most recent allocation straight from Nomad's HTTP API — backs GET /apps/:appName/logs.
build-diagnostics.js Makes a failed build readable.
build-info.js Which code this process is running, read once at startup and reported by GET /health.

build-plan.js Asks Railpack what it WOULD do with an uploaded app, without building anything — `railpack info --format json` runs the same detection `railpack build` starts with, stopped before BuildKit is involved.

claim-project.js Confirms (and, on first sight, auto-creates) that an app name is actually available to the deploying company BEFORE any build/Nomad resources are spent on it — see hostnsoft-api's src/routes/internalProj

customer-query.js (renamed from feature-request.js, 2026-09-09 — hostnsoft-api's endpoint moved from /internal/feature-requests to /internal/customer-query, same underlying table/type) Forwards an agent-submitted feature

deploy-credential.js Reads whichever credential a POST /apps request presented, and packages it for the two hostnsoft-api calls a deploy makes (claim-project.js and record-deployment.js) so neither has to know which kind

deploy-in-flight.js Which apps have a deploy running in this process right now — from the moment hostnsoft-api has claimed the name for it until the build and Nomad deploy have finished, success or failure.

deploy-response.js One shape for every agent-facing reply of this service — POST /apps, GET /apps/:appName/status, GET /apps/:appName/logs, and their errors: { status, app, next, links } status — where things stand, one
deploy-status.js In-process, in-memory record of each app's most recent deploy attempt — backs GET /apps/:appName/status.

detect-manifest-root.js Confirms a freshly extracted upload actually has a buildable manifest (or, for a static site, an index.html) at buildDir's own root — the same rule scripts/deploy.sh and SKILL.md already state to
detect-storage-usage.js Cheap check for `window.storage` usage (Claude Artifacts' storage API, which doesn't exist outside that sandbox).
detect-timers.js Spots apps that run timed jobs from inside the process (node-cron, APScheduler...).
embarko-config.js Reads the app's optional embarko.json from the uploaded archive, before the claim and before anything is extracted or built.
Reports which apps are idle and, with --apply, stops them.
image-registry.js Copies every freshly built image into the host's local registry (server-setup.md#image-registry).

image-retention.js Keeps only the N most recently built local images for an app, deleting older ones — bounds disk usage on a host that never pushes images to a registry (every build lives here forever otherwise), while
internal-auth.js Authenticates hostnsoft-api's own calls INTO this service (e.g.

logger.js Every log line in this service goes through here so they all share one shape: `<ISO timestamp> <request id>: <message>`.

Exact-ID Nomad job lookups.
proxy.js — orphan-expiry banner injector, language/framework-agnostic.

project-lookup.js Read-only counterpart to claim-project.js — calls hostnsoft-api's POST /internal/projects/lookup to find out whether an app name exists, whether it's an unclaimed orphan, and which company owns it, WITH
record-deployment.js Reports a deploy attempt's state to hostnsoft-api so the dashboard's deployment history is actually populated — see hostnsoft-api's src/routes/internalDeployments.routes.ts.
rename-app.js — move a deployed app from one name to another.

sqlite-data-check.js — the part of the activator's wake-time data check that knows what a SQLite checkpoint looks like.

tables.name: tail_state
tables.note: One row, keyed by the log file's own path — lets the tailer resume from where it left off across restarts, and detect rotation (a changed inode, or a file that's now smaller than our last offset).
